title: Data-driven Reduced-order Modeling of a Multistable Viscoelastic Flow
abstract: arXiv:2611.32818v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Viscoelastic flow past two side-by-side microcylinders has been shown to exhibit geometry-dependent transitions among symmetric, converging, diverging, and asymmetric-diverging flow states, together with regions of bistability and tristability. Here, we develop a data-driven framework for learning a two-dimensional, parameter-dependent normal form for this bifurcation structure from sparse measurements of stable flow states. We use the flow asymmetry parameters $I'$ and $I''$ as state variables, with the gap ratio $G$ and Weissenberg number $Wi$ as control parameters. In the absence of trajectory data, the measured steady states are enforced as stable equilibria of the learned vector field through equilibrium and local-stability constraints. translated_title: 多稳态粘弹性流动的数据驱动降阶建模
translated_abstract: 并排双微圆柱绕流的粘弹性流动已被证明会表现出依赖于几何构型的流态转变，即在对称、汇聚、发散和非对称发散等流动状态之间的转换，同时存在双稳态和三稳态区域。在此，我们开发了一个数据驱动框架，用于从稳定流态的稀疏测量数据中学习描述该分岔结构的二维、参数依赖的正规形。我们采用流动不对称参数 $I'$ 和 $I''$ 作为状态变量，以间隙比 $G$ 和魏森贝格数 $Wi$ 作为控制参数。在缺乏轨迹数据的情况下，通过平衡态约束和局部稳定性约束，将测得的稳态强制为学习所得向量场的稳定平衡点。我们考察了该正规形的多项式和神经网络两种表示形式，并将物理反射对称性直接融入模型之中。所得模型恢复了观测到的分岔结构（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种数据驱动框架，仅利用稳定流态的稀疏稳态测量数据，并通过平衡态约束、稳定性约束和物理反射对称性，学习出能够刻画并排双微圆柱粘弹性流动多稳态分岔结构的二维参数依赖正规形模型。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a data-driven framework that learns a two-dimensional, parameter-dependent normal form capturing the multistable bifurcation structure of viscoelastic flow past side-by-side microcylinders, using only sparse measurements of stable states with equilibrium, stability, and reflection-symmetry constraints.
